title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
authors: John Jumper;Richard Evans;Alexander Pritzel;Tim Green;Michael Figurnov;Olaf Ronneberger;Demis Hassabis;et al.
abstract: We provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even where no similar structure is known.

title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction for the human proteome
abstract: We provide accurate structure predictions for the human proteome.

title: Graph Networks for Materials Science
authors: Christopher Sutton;Mara Graziani;Tian Xie;Tim Hsu;Brandon Ayers;Sohrab Fathi;Timothy S. Carlsson;et al.
abstract: We discuss the application of graph neural networks to materials science.

title: A universal SNP and small-indel variant caller using deep neural networks
authors: Ryan Poplin;Pieter-Chang Chang;David Alexander;Scott Schwartz;Thomas Colthurst;Alexander Ku;Daniel Newburger;et al.
abstract: We present DeepVariant a deep convolutional neural network for variant calling from next-generation DNA sequencing data.

title: Skilful precipitation nowcasting using deep generative models of radar
authors: Yi-Ling Harn;Tobias S. Finn;Andrew C. Schembri;et al.
abstract: We present a deep generative model for the probabilistic nowcasting of precipitation from radar.

title: Physics-informed neural networks: A deep learning framework for solving forward and inverse problems involving nonlinear partial differential equations
abstract: We introduce physics-informed neural networks PINNs for solving PDEs.

title: Deep DTA: Deep Drug-Target Binding Affinity Prediction
abstract: We propose a deep learning model for predicting drug-target binding affinity.

title: Junction Tree Variational Autoencoder for Molecular Graph Generation
abstract: We propose a junction tree based VAE for molecular graph generation.
